articles.title: CFTC issues warning over risky prediction market ‘mention’ contracts
articles.description: The warning comes weeks after the CFTC fined a former White House teleprompter operator who made more than $107,000 trading prediction contracts tied to President Trump’s speeches.

articles.title: U.S. regulator warns about cheating risks in 'mention markets' on prediction platforms
articles.description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission issued a new advisory to flag the unique dangers of markets based on individuals' behavior.

articles.title: Trump administration is examining whether a diesel export ban is feasible, Treasury Secretary says
articles.description: Republican lawmakers have called for an export ban as high diesel prices hit farmers and truckers ahead of the November midterm elections.

articles.title: Here's who we know is going to the Trump-Xi dinner so far
articles.description: Very little is known about which Chinese business executives, if any, are expected to attend.

articles.title: Qantas to start selling tickets next year for its New York to Sydney nonstop flight
articles.description: Qantas plans to start selling tickets for its first New York to Sydney nonstop flight.

articles.title: Lennar shares pop as Berkshire builds almost a 10% stake in beleaguered homebuilder
articles.description: The conglomerate built by Warren Buffett and led today by Greg Abel holds a sizable stake in Miami-based homebuilder Lennar.

articles.title: UN Security Council Will Get Advice on AI Risks From Tech Giants Building It
articles.description: DeepSeek will address the UN Security Council on AI risks this week, sharing a stage with Dario Amodei—who has spent a year calling China's government the industry's biggest threat.

articles.title: Trump discloses more than 1,100 July trades, including up to $25 million each in sales of Microsoft, Amazon
articles.description: Trump sold tech stocks including Amazon and Microsoft when the Mag 7 stocks popped on July 20, adding $291 billion in market value in one day.

articles.title: Democrats 'chose visceral hatred for' Donald Trump over crypto Clarity Act, Lummis says
articles.description: Senator Cynthia Lummis said the crypto industry should "pin it on the Democrats" in her first public remarks after last week's failed Clarity Act vote.

articles.title: Royal Caribbean nears $3 billion deal to take 50% equity stake in Sandals
articles.description: Royal Caribbean has been trying to diversify beyond cruises and become a leader overall in vacations.

articles.title: $161 Million in Decade-Old Bitcoin Has Moved in Just Two Weeks
articles.description: Four ancient wallets moved 1,971 BTC between Sept. 6 and Sept. 22, including a 600 BTC transfer worth $51.9 million just hours ago, with three of the four carrying "Noah Doe" lawsuit tags.

articles.title: Trump administration removes around 760,000 Obamacare enrollments, alleging fraud
articles.description: Vice President JD Vance's White House Task Force to Eliminate Fraud estimates the action will save roughly $2.2 billion in taxpayer-funded subsidies.

articles.title: Arch Lending eyes tokenized stocks as next collateral market
articles.description: Arch Lending’s Himanshu Sahay said on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast that the lender plans to move into tokenized equities as onchain stocks gain traction as collateral.

articles.title: Republican senator calls for probe into US presidents’ sons, citing crypto ventures
articles.description: Many Democrats have previously called for investigations into the Trump family’s crypto ventures, but now a Republican is asking for an inquiry based on ties to the presidency.

articles.title: Cisco stock sinks 5% after Piper Sandler cuts price target on growth concerns
articles.description: Cisco stock hit a record over the summer, but Piper Sandler analysts expressed concerns that growth is peaking in the industry.

articles.title: U.S. regulators rush to write crypto rulebook after Clarity Act stalls in Senate
articles.description: State and federal regulators are rushing to fill the void after comprehensive crypto rules failed to clear the Senate.

articles.title: CME Expands Crypto Futures Lineup With Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap
articles.description: The exchange operator is adding standard and micro contracts for BCH and UNI, extending a pattern of altcoin rollouts that already covers Cardano, Chainlink, Stellar, Avalanche, and Sui.

articles.title: A top chip stock analyst sees big things for Nvidia, Broadcom. How his case aligns with ours
articles.description: The bullish sentiment comes despite calls to slow down AI model development and rekindled investor enthusiasm for a competing part of the AI chip ecosystem.

articles.title: Crypto market structure can't wait for shot at post-election Clarity Act surge: White House
articles.description: White House and U.S. Treasury officials agree that despite some hope that Congress' "lame duck" session could see the bill again, the work's in regulators' hands.

articles.title: Oil prices fall for fifth day after Trump says U.S. met with Iran for three hours
articles.description: Oil prices reversed early gains on Tuesday amid optimism that prospects for a diplomatic solution to the U.S.-Iran war are improving.
